name: Cafe Rosarita
notes: No own website reachable (caferosarita.com tripped antivirus on fetch; not retried, blocking that domain specifically). Filed as tier-3 marketplace; no independent cross-check found.

name: Mille Fleurs
notes: First-party Wix site, address confirmed exactly (6009 Paseo Delicias, Rancho Santa Fe, CA 92067; menu dated "as of September 3, 2026" on the page). The site publishes only one price on the entire menu: a single $60 four-course prix-fixe covering all of Dinner (and, per its own tab structure, Dessert and Lunch). Every individual dish in the underlying Wix Restaurants Menus app JSON carries priceInfo.price: "0" (checked all ~35 items across all sections) - there is no per-item price anywhere, only the flat prix-fixe figure. This matches the fine-dining "prices only the tasting menu" case; no itemised menu exists to capture.

name: Theos Hot Pizza
notes: No usable own site (theoshotpizza.com routes to a browser-only POS widget per the work-list router note). notes: Own site (getngodonuts.com) 404s. Read from UberEats catalogSectionsMap (37 items across 4 sections: Fancy Donuts/Croissants, Specials, Regular Donuts, Beverage). Address on the UberEats listing is "6986 El Camino Real", not "6996 El Camino Real #e" as given in the work list - a 10-number difference; same name, same city (Carlsbad), so treated as the same restaurant with a work-list transcription discrepancy, flagged here rather than silently corrected. All prices land on quarter-dollar increments (.00/.25/.50/.75) with no odd cents at all, consistent with genuine register pricing; small full menu for a donut shop (donuts + drinks), no sections missing that would be expected of this concept.

name: Jitters Coffee Pub
notes: First-party Squarespace site, address matches work list (510 N Coast Hwy, Oceanside). Breakfast and Lunch sections are fully priced (10 items) and filed as-is. The "Espresso Drinks" list (Espresso, Cortado, Latte, Cappuccino, White Mocha, Americano, Espritizo, Cold Brew, Drip Coffee, Mexican Mocha, Caramel Macchiato, Chai Latte, London Fog, Matcha Latte) and a "From The Bar" section are both present on the page as plain static text with item names only - no prices anywhere in the served HTML, and no hidden tab/JSON payload found carrying them. For a shop named "Coffee Pub" that is the core menu, not an adjunct, so this is filed as a partial: food items captured, coffee/bar pricing genuinely unpublished on this source.
